tess: Heads up - canary 2026-03-10 deploy showing 2.3x p95 for seqlen > 1024. Looks like selector chose fallback scalar path more often on H100 pool. :eyes:
chris: ack. any logs? can you paste selector output?
sam: pinging for logs, will help triage.
tess: pasted logs:
```
[selector] kernel_choice=vectorized_16x; reason=seqlen_bucket(<=512); score=0.82
[selector] kernel_choice=scalar_fallback; reason=est_latency(>slo); score=0.47; fallback_from=vectorized_32x
trace: batch_hint=16 kv_hit_rate=0.12
```
sam: kv_hit_rate 0.12 is low, cache cold?
tess: cache warm in load test, kv_hit_rate ~0.7 for short seqs. This only triggers for long seqs during regen loop.
jonah: could be batching heuristics. Did runtime enable adaptive_batching_tuner?
tess: yes, tuner enabled. suspect autotune score normalization favors scalar at high seqlen on H100 microbenchmarks. want more telemetry: enable SELECTOR_VERBOSE=1 and SELECTOR_SAMPLERATE=0.005 to stream reasons.
chris: try turning on SELECTOR_PROFILE=seq-latency and ramp PICK_SAMPLER=1 for short window.
dev-bot: deployed flag SELECTOR_VERBOSE=1 to canary on pool h100-canary
tess: re-run short perf with SELECTOR_VERBOSE=1. attaching new trace:
```
trace_id=tx-12345
candidate:[vectorized_32x] est_p95=74ms cpu=0.42 mem=1.2GB score=0.65
candidate:[vectorized_16x] est_p95=96ms cpu=0.35 mem=0.9GB score=0.59
candidate:[scalar_fallback] est_p95=80ms cpu=0.20 mem=0.3GB score=0.72
final_choice=scalar_fallback reason="normalized_score>threshold && kv_efficiency<0.2"
```
tess: note normalized score pushed scalar up because kv_efficiency penalizes vectorized candidates for kv cache misses. That seems overly aggressive for seqlen 1200.
sam: can we tweak kv penalty factor? there's env KVPENALTY_FACTOR=1.5 default.
tess: tried KVPENALTY_FACTOR=0.8 locally - vectorized wins. Want to roll to canary with KVPENALTY_FACTOR=0.9 and SELECTOR_SAMPLERATE=0.02, observe p95.
jonah: +1. Also add telemetry tag "seq_bucket=1024-2048" to traces.
tess: will roll in 10m. thanks :thumbsup:
ingest-bot: added trace tags for tx-12345 (seq_bucket=1024-2048, kv_eff=0.12, pool=h100-canary)
